title: Large-folio batched unmap scans beyond the current PTE table

classification.cwe_mapping_note: These are evaluator classifications; the linked Linux CVE announcement does not assign an official CWE.

finding.missing_bound: The batched unmap scan is capped by the folio size and remaining VMA pages but not by the number of entries left in the current PTE table.
finding.control_flow: At PTE index 510 in a 512-entry table, a four-page folio with four VMA pages remaining produces a four-entry scan even though only entries 510 and 511 are valid in that table.
finding.impact: The original Linux path can read page-table entries beyond the end of the current PTE table during a userspace-triggerable large-folio unmap.
finding.security_property: A batched PTE walk must not scan beyond either the VMA boundary or the current PMD/PTE-table boundary.
finding.expected_fix: Cap the batch at the earlier of the VMA end and PMD end, permit a partial large-folio batch, and continue walking after that bounded batch.
finding.model_boundary: MiniMM reports scan counts and the first invalid index as bounded metadata. It never allocates or dereferences a host PTE table, performs an out-of-bounds read, unmaps a host VMA, or modifies a host folio.
